i1.title: Mont Blanc Explorer Infinite Eau de Parfum 60ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A fresh new direction for the Explorer journey.

Mont Blanc Explorer Infinite Eau de Parfum 60ml is a fresh woody fragrance for men, created by perfumers Jordi Fernandez and Antoine Maisondieu and launched in 2026. A bright, zesty opening leads into a deep heart of patchouli, giving this newest Explorer a clean, modern character with an earthy, woody trail.

Scent pyramid

  • Heart: Patchouli

Key details

  • Brand: Mont Blanc
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 60ml
  • Scent profile: Fresh · Woody
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • The newest addition to the Explorer family
  • A deep, earthy patchouli heart
  • A clean, fresh woody character
  • A handy 60ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Explorer Infinite smell like?

Patchouli.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.

i4.title: Mont Blanc Individuel Eau de Toilette 75ml
i4.descriptionHtml:
Warm, spicy and quietly distinctive.

Mont Blanc Individuel Eau de Toilette 75ml is a woody oriental fragrance for men, created by perfumer Pierre Bourdon and launched in 2003. Bergamot, juniper berry, lavender and a touch of cinnamon and coriander open it with a fresh, spicy energy, a soft heart of orange blossom, violet and jasmine follows, and it settles onto a warm base of sandalwood, tonka bean, amber, patchouli and musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Bergamot, Juniper Berry, Lavender, Cinnamon, Coriander
  • Heart: Orange Blossom, Violet, Jasmine
  • Base: Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Amber, Patchouli, Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Mont Blanc
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 75ml
  • Scent profile: Oriental · Woody
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A fresh, spicy juniper and bergamot opening
  • A soft orange blossom and violet heart
  • A warm sandalwood, tonka and amber base
  • A classic Montblanc since 2003

FAQ

What does Montblanc Individuel smell like?

i5.title: Mont Blanc Legend Aftershave Lotion 100ml
i5.descriptionHtml:
The fresh Legend signature, for the finishing touch after shaving.

Mont Blanc Legend Aftershave Lotion 100ml carries the fresh, aromatic fougère character of Montblanc Legend, created by perfumer Olivier Pescheux in 2011. Lavender and bergamot open it with a clean freshness, a soft rose heart follows, and it settles into warm sandalwood, tonka bean and an oakmoss accord.

  • Heart: Rose
  • Base: Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Oakmoss Accord

How to use

After shaving, pour a little into your hands and apply to the face and neck.
